name: Trellus
tagline: Embedded AI auto-dialer and live cold-call coach for SDRs.
description: A sales calling copilot that embeds a parallel/auto-dialer and real-time coaching directly inside sales engagement platforms. Listens to live calls and surfaces behavioral cues and objection-handling prompts, then scores talk tracks and analyzes calls afterward.
insight: Backed by Y Combinator (W22) and founded by former MIT researchers Craig Bonnoit and Ajinkya Nene.
edge: Embeds a parallel dialer plus live in-call coaching inside Salesloft, Outreach, HubSpot and Apollo, pitched as far cheaper than standalone parallel dialers.
pros: Parallel dialing to lift connect rates
cons: Value tied to high call volume
Coaching quality varies by call audio
